intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: Machum Studio is a lifelong quest to capture the extraordinary in the ordinary. We freeze fleeting moments in time and turn them into stories you can return to again and again. Based in Seoul, we photograph people, events, brands and products, and try to hold the mood of the day and the feeling of the people in every frame. Let's make something worth remembering together.

events.name: Events
events.body: Our event photography service is dedicated to capturing the magic of your special occasions. Whether it's a wedding, corporate event, or milestone celebration, we're there to document every heartfelt moment. We blend into the background, ensuring natural and candid shots that reflect the emotions of the day.

highlights.coverage: Coverage for weddings, parties, corporate functions, and more.
highlights.moment: Skilled photographers who know how to seize the moment.
highlights.story: A mix of candid and posed shots for a comprehensive story.
highlights.delivery: Quick turnaround for you to relive the day's highlights.

portrait.name: Portrait
portrait.body: Our portrait photography service is all about showcasing your unique personality. Whether you need a professional headshot, a family portrait, or a couple's session, we keep things relaxed and guide you toward natural expressions and poses. We choose the light and location around you, so you get a picture you'll want to look back on for years.

highlights.style: Headshots, family and couple portraits that show who you are.
highlights.direction: Gentle posing guidance, even if it's your first shoot.
highlights.location: Studio or outdoor sessions, wherever you feel at home.
highlights.retouch: Natural retouching that keeps skin tones and colors true.

commercial.name: Commercial
commercial.body: In the world of business, a compelling image can make all the difference. Our commercial photography service is designed to show your products, spaces, and brand at their best. We start by listening to the message you want to send, then shoot with the framing and color that suit where the images will be used.

highlights.product: Detail and lifestyle shots that bring out texture and color.
highlights.space: Bright, spacious shots of shops, offices, and guesthouses.
highlights.brand: A shooting direction aligned with your brand identity.
highlights.files: High-resolution files ready for web and print.

specialty.question: What type of photography do you specialize in?
specialty.answer: We specialize in portrait, event, commercial and wedding photography, capturing moments that tell unique stories.

booking.question: How can I book a photography session with you?
booking.answer: Send us your preferred date and type of shoot from the Contact page, and we'll get back to you with availability and a quote within a day.

equipment.question: What equipment do you use for your photography?
equipment.answer: We shoot with two full-frame mirrorless bodies and a mix of prime and zoom lenses, and bring portable lighting for indoor sessions.

location.question: Can I request a specific location for a photoshoot?
location.answer: Yes. If you have a place in mind, we'll scout it before the shoot. If not, we'll suggest locations that fit the mood.

editing.question: What is your editing process like?
editing.answer: We pick the best shots, balance color and exposure, and retouch skin and backgrounds naturally for portraits.

files.question: Are digital files included in your photography packages?
files.answer: Every package includes high-resolution edited files, and original files are available on request.

prints.question: Do you offer prints of your photographs?
prints.answer: Yes, prints are available. Let us know the sizes and quantities you'd like through the Contact page, and we'll send you pricing.

delivery.question: How long does it take to receive the edited photos after a session?
delivery.answer: Usually within two weeks, delivered through an online gallery. Weddings take three to four weeks.

metadata.title: About | Machum Studio
metadata.description: From a first camera in 2005 to portraits, events, and brands: the story and journey of Machum Studio.

hero.title: About Machum Studio
hero.scroll: Scroll down to see our journey

paragraphs.origin: Machum Studio's love affair with photography began early, nurtured by seaside towns and the people of busy market streets. A passion for telling stories through images started a journey that has now spanned over 15 years.
paragraphs.craft: Driven by curiosity to find beauty in everyday moments, we have honed our craft step by step. A background in digital media gives us a solid foundation, but it's a keen eye for detail and an ability to capture real emotion that sets our work apart.
paragraphs.promise: For us, a shoot is more than taking pictures; it's about capturing the human spirit, the fleeting magic of nature, and the emotions that define our lives. With each click of the shutter, we weave stories that transcend time and space.

items.2005: We acquired our first camera, igniting a passion for photography, experimenting with landscapes and candid shots and beginning our visual storytelling.
items.2010: We studied visual arts with a focus on photography, refining our technical skills and artistic sensibilities.
items.2012: We held our first solo exhibition, showcasing a unique perspective on nature and people through our lens.
items.2015: Machum Studio officially launched, offering portrait, event, and commercial photography services.
items.2017: Our work took us abroad, capturing breathtaking scenes and cultures from around the world.
items.2020: Our dedication and creativity earned several prestigious photography awards, establishing us as a storytelling studio.
